operations.name: report.exam.run
operations.purpose: Run an examination report from the catalogue.

parameters.name: report_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No examination report this reader may run matches — the catalogue offers only what the role permits.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching reports from the catalogue.

parameters.notes: The report, from the catalogue's examination group: Marks entry status; Result sheet per class and section; Report card per student; Subject-wise performance and pass rate; Grade distribution; Merit list; Students absent from an exam; Grace marks awarded by teacher; Term-on-term comparison per student. Only the reports the reader's role permits are offered.

parameters.name: exam_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No exam this reader may see matches.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching exams with their session and term.

parameters.notes: The exam the report covers (BR-2, E3).

parameters.name: class_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No class this reader may see matches.

parameters.notes: Where the report covers a class. A Coordinator is offered the classes they supervise.

parameters.name: section_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No section this reader may see matches.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching sections with their class.

parameters.notes: Where the report covers a section.

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.notes: The reader. Every run is recorded against them. Never from the request.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: result_id
fields.description: The run. It is taken away with report.export — UC-24-19.

fields.name: parameters
fields.description: The period and scope it ran with, as printed on any output.

fields.name: paged
fields.description: True where the result is paged rather than shown whole.

fields.name: marks_locked
fields.description: Whether the marks shown are approved and locked. A result report does not run without it (BR-3).

fields.name: subjects_outstanding
fields.description: On marks-entry status: which subjects remain unentered (BR-4).

fields.name: merit_visibility
fields.description: How the merit list may be shown, from the decision recorded when it was published (BR-5).

fields.name: grace_by_teacher
fields.description: On grace marks: grouped by the teacher who awarded them (BR-6).

errors.meaning: The marks have not been approved and locked.
errors.notWritten: A result report does not run.
errors.note: Marks-entry status is the one report that runs on unlocked marks (BR-4).

errors.meaning: The reader does not hold the permission for this report.

errors.note: Shown empty and said so, rather than appearing to have failed.

operations.writesOnRead: The run is recorded — who ran it, which report and over what scope (BR-9).

planningRules.rule: Never produce a result from unlocked marks. A result sheet, a report card, performance, the distribution and the merit list each run only once the marks are approved and locked; a result produced earlier is one the school has to take back (BR-3, E1, AC-1, AC-4).
Marks-entry status is the exception. It runs on unlocked marks, since showing what is not yet done is its purpose (BR-4, A2, AC-2).
Show the merit list only as the school decided when it was published — never more widely than that decision, whatever the report could show (BR-5, A3, E6, AC-6).
Group grace marks by teacher. A teacher awarding grace far more often than their colleagues is what the report exists to surface (BR-6, A4, AC-7).
Show an unresolved exam absence as absent, never as a zero (E4, AC-8).
Say that the report card's own rules are unsettled — whether a fee balance withholds it, what it shows for an incomplete subject, and which term it covers (OQ-1, OQ-2, OQ-3).
Never correct anything from a report. A wrong mark is corrected through the marks correction route (BR-8, E5, AC-9).
Report an empty result as an answer, not a failure.
Say that the run is recorded, and take the report away only through report.export — UC-24-19. There is no route out of its own (BR-9, BR-10).
staff_id and branch_id come from $session. A figure across branches is report.combined.run — the Super Admin's alone.

reversal.statement: A report changes nothing a plan can take back. The record of the run stands (BR-9).
